changelog:
- This version announces that the "research-daily-push" skill has been integrated into the unified "research" skill entry.
- The original skill is retained for backward compatibility; all features are now accessed via the unified "research" interface.
- New recommended usage: use "research daily [领域]" for daily literature push.
- Old usage ("daily [领域]") still works and automatically redirects.
- Existing features remain: daily retrieval and structured summary of recent arXiv papers, importance rating, and multi-platform push support.
